Exclusion and inclusion criteria of THE World University Rankings  (2025 THE World University Rankings Methodology, p. 7)  https://www.timeshighereducation.com/sites/default/ fi les/breaking_news_ fi les/the_2025_  world_university_rankings_methodology.pdf  THE World University Rankings  Inclusion Criteria   CLSU Status  There are seven key criteria for universities to be  included in the Rankings:  1. They are required to publish   more than 1,000  relevant (Scopus indexed) publications over the  previous 5 years , and   more than 100 relevant  (Scopus indexed) publications in any single year . This  criterion was based on the publication count including  kilo-authored fractional counting until the rankings  published in 2023, when we changed to the full  publication count.  Compliance not yet met  CLSU Scopus indexed publications  2019:   58  2020:   104  2021:   82  2022:   93  2023:   105  2024:   147  2025:   74 and counting  2. They must teach at an undergraduate level, usually  indicated by having more than zero undergraduate  degrees awarded. Postgraduate-only institutions are  therefore not in the ranking.  Complied  3. They must not be focused on a single narrow  subject area (more than 80% of their publication  output is from one subject area).   Complied  4. They must have supplied “overall” numbers for the  ranking year.   Complied  5. They must not have more than two of the critical  values (academic staff, international academic staff,  research staff, students, international students,  undergraduate degrees awarded, doctorates awarded,  institutional income, research income, research  income from industry and commerce) as empty,  unavailable, or withheld. Missing values will cause any  metric based on that value to also be invalid.  Complied  6. They must mark at least one subject as applicable. If  no applicable subjects have been reported the  institution is excluded.   Complied  7. They must not be featured in the custom exclusions  list. Institutions that have requested not to participate  in the ranking or that are not eligible for other  institution-speci fi c reasons have been excluded.  Complied  2
